composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Yuta Okkotsu with his tousled dark hair and gentle youthful features, holding a plain closed book against his chest. Use a loose cream overshirt over a navy T-shirt, with natural teenage proportions and an unforced posture. His head tilts only a little, and he looks up toward the viewer with a shy but clear smile. Apply soft opaque gouache in broad clothing planes, with subtle paper presence and crisp facial marks. Keep the background mostly warm ivory, interrupted by one muted blue oval. The book carries no title, and the hands remain low and anatomically simple. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
